name: Havuç
notes: Small opening-level design; 22 closed coloured panes counted by connected components and visually reviewed: 5 root bands, 3 leaves and 14 background pieces. Subject uses orange/green; background uses cobalt/turquoise. Opaque white exterior, portrait 1086x1448. Regenerated once to simplify the crown and root. No obvious open lines or X crossings. Remaining doubts: slight generated shading remains rather than perfectly flat fills; two orange side leaves touch the orange root shoulder and may merge during tracing; the left leaf base is relatively narrow and should be checked at playing scale. Palette values are the requested colour targets. Design sheet only, not traced or published.

generation.promptSummary: Tall oval carrot panel with five alternating orange/green root bands, three broad leaves, calm cobalt/turquoise background bands, thick closed black lead, spaced T junctions, four flat colour targets, white exterior and 12–22 panes.
